newsitem.title: USA: AMRE chairman steps down, remains director.
newsitem.headline: AMRE chairman steps down, remains director.

text.p: AMRE Inc said Tuesday that its chairman, John Snodgrass, is leaving the post to avoid any potential conflicts of interests that may arise from AMRE's deferred royalty payments to HFS Inc.
Snodgrass is HFS president, vice-chairman and chief operating officer.

Earlier Tuesday AMRE said it had agreed in principle with HFS to defer $9.6 million of its 1996 royalty payment to HFS, to modify its 1997 royalty payment and to restructure terms of future royalty payments.
AMRE said Snodgrass will remain an AMRE director. The company said another company director, Jack McDonald, will be acting chairman until a successor is named.
